calls.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python - <<'PY'
import csv,json
p='submission/desync_log.csv'
with open('assets/form_schema.json') as f: ids={x['id'] for x in json.load(f)['fields']}
with open(p,newline='') as f: rows=list(csv.DictReader(f))
assert rows and list(rows[0]) == ['event_idx','sr_field','visual_field','desync']
assert len(rows)==6
assert [int(r['event_idx']) for r in rows]==list(range(1,7))
assert all(r['sr_field'] in ids and r['visual_field'] in ids for r in rows)
assert all(r['desync']==('yes' if r['sr_field']!=r['visual_field'] else 'no') for r in rows)
print(open(p).read(), end='')
print('VALID: header, 6 ordered rows, canonical IDs, and desync values checked')
PY","workdir":"/app","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":2000}); text(r.output)
